tagline.en_US: Nzbget is a usenet downloader, written in C++ and designed with performance in mind to achieve maximum download speed by using very little system resources.

description.en_US: Nzbget is a Usenet downloader written in C++. It is designed with performance in mind to achieve maximum download speeds while using minimal system resources. It offers a web interface for managing, monitoring, and scheduling download queues.

tips: To enable scheduling, configure the time correction value in settings/logging.
